Subject: Interim notice: RayTel telemetry relay added as subprocessor (EU)

Hi Alyssa / ClearBank legal team —

Quick heads up: we have provisionally added RayTel (raytel-telemetry) as a telemetry relay subprocessor to handle burst telemetry ingestion for EU customers while we finalize capacity upgrades. This is an interim, capacity-driven addition (no change to customer-facing product) and will only be used for telemetry/metrics (no raw customer data or PII).

What were sharing now:
- A short notice (attached) summarizing the scope and expected timeline (attached: redwood_subproc_addition_notice_v1.pdf).
- Current subprocessor roster (attached: subprocessor_roster_Q4_2026.xlsx).

Key points:
- Region: EU-only (eu-west-1), telemetry ingestion only.
- Data types: aggregated telemetry + service logs; default retention 30 days.
- Encryption: TLS in transit; KV-level encryption handled by our KMS (Redwood KMS, keys in EU).
- Onboarding status: RayTel has completed a preliminary security questionnaire; full evidence pack (SOC2 snapshot, encryption attestation, escrow proof) is pending.

Action requested from ClearBank legal / security: please confirm whether this interim relay requires an onshore escrow/holdback or an expedited DPA addendum signature from your side. If you need supporting documents, we can share the SOC2 snapshot under NDA and a packaged evidence zip.

Please acknowledge within 48 hours if any customer-impact or procurement approvals are needed on your side. If we dont hear back we will proceed under our standard interim controls and route only telemetry signals (non-PII) through RayTel.

Thanks —
David Kim
Director, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
